title: [Peek] Enable reusable previewers for Peek to fix flicker
author: daverayment
summary: Resumed the existing PowerToys PR 49963 review state instead of restarting. The existing fork-side fix was rebased onto run-plan upstream head 369613511a69edd37b3079e00a3ceed362035d49, pushed as a new review branch because force-push to the prior branch was blocked, and a fresh Copilot review was requested before the no-new-review cutoff. No upstream write was made.

blockers.detail: After committing and pushing fork-side fix 2095dbd03a3010f0761369c703d3dcbf15d30e75, a fresh Copilot review was requested before cutoff at 2026-09-08T17:47Z and submitted at 2026-09-08T17:52:33Z.
